claim_boundary: This source record can establish catalogue coordinates. It cannot establish DERD compatibility, literal internal Keplerian motion, a universal transparent shell, or stellar/shell mass.
scope: Authoritative identity, subtype, primary-period and crosswalk coordinates for OGLE-IV LMC Delta Scuti metadata locks.

sources.evidence_use: Primary authority for exact OGLE-IV identity, catalogue subtype, OGLE-III cross-reference, primary period and uncertainty.
sources.rights_boundary: Citation acknowledgement required; raw catalogue bytes are not bundled until a redistribution basis is recorded.

sources.identity_schema_role: Fixed-width object ID, subtype, sky coordinates and OGLE-IV/III/II aliases.
sources.parameter_schema_role: Fixed-width mean photometry, primary period, period error, epoch, amplitude and optional additional periods.

sources.mode_boundary: The catalogue reported multimode objects but did not unambiguously identify the radial mode of its single-mode objects; Phase 10 therefore preserves singlemode as radial-order unresolved.

sources.role: Independent current service-discovery coordinate only; not substituted for frozen authoritative catalogue files.
